name: pricing-table
title: Pricing table
description: One group of prices: its case on the left, its cards on the right in the double rule. Each card's price large in tabular figures with its unit, one line, and what it includes led by the red square.
use_for: A pricing page, one table per group of prices.
never: A plan marked as the popular one: the prices make the case
A button on every card: the page's head carries the one action
source: conare-web app/pages/pricing.vue (each group: its case, its cards in the double rule), app/content/pricing.ts
body: Give each table its own `titleId` when a page has several. An odd last card takes the whole row.

examples.name: Site
examples.label: One group of prices
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import PricingTable from '@/components/site/PricingTable.vue'
// One group of prices: its case on the left, the cards beside it; the odd last card takes the row.
const cards = [
  {
    "name": "Connected apps",
    "amount": "$20",
    "unit": "per app a month",
    "line": "Each app you connect, synced as it changes.",
    "facts": [
      "Changes in minutes",
      "Deletes carried over"
    ]
  },
  {
    "name": "Parsing",
    "amount": "$3",
    "unit": "per 1,000 pages",
    "line": "Every page read in full, tables included.",
    "facts": [
      "Scanned and typed pages",
      "Tables kept as tables"
    ]
  },
  {
    "name": "Embeddings",
    "amount": "$0.02",
    "unit": "per 1M tokens",
    "line": "For any vector database you run.",
    "facts": []
  }
]
</script>

<template>
  <PricingTable
    title-id="pricing-sync"
    title="Sync"
    body="Keep your apps in a namespace, in step as they change."
    :cards="cards"
  />
</template>
